mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 10.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending power and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 10.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a contraction in the housing sector, which is a key component of consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in RSAFS and HOUST fails to predict negative 20d returns in > 60% of cases (i.e., Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 100.0 (index 2017=100), it signals a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) relative to its 12-month moving average signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in expanding labor markets are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% signals accelerating inflation that pressures central banks to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL 12m change > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a severe labor market deterioration that reduces household income and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint rise in UNRATE and decline in PAYEMS fails to predict negative 20d returns in > 60% of cases (i.e., Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (RSAFS) relative to its 12-month moving average signals a strengthening housing market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in expanding housing markets are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
